name: App Jaanch
description: Check an APK, EXE or app file someone sent before installing it: dangerous permissions (SMS / OTP, accessibility, device admin), hidden icon, signer, company, and bank / KYC / challan scam names. The file is never run
notes: Driven by the app_check tool. Uses REA (github.com/morluto/rea, MIT, pinned rea-agents 6.7.0) on the server in static-analysis-only mode: runtime, debugger, Frida, adb and browser tools are blocked
